full_judgment: 2. The facts involved in the case, in short, are that the plaintiffs are the co-sharers by inheritance in the land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 243 corresponding to S.A. Khatian Nos. 244 and 245. The defendants namely Makhon Lal and his wife Dipali Rani were the owners of 3.89 ½  acres of land described in said khatians and they conjointly by a registered deed of Iwaznama dated 18.06.1987 transferred the land measuring an area of 3.89 ½  acres in favour of defendant Nos. land 2-pre-emptees. They registered a deed of ewaznama instead of kabala deed to defeat the right of pre-emption. The land measuring an area of 3.89 ½  acres of the vendors described in schedule was shown to have been exchanged with 0.581/2 acres of land of the pre-emptees described in schedule 'Kha' of the plaint,— Subsequently,--land measuring 0.581/2 acres was transferred to Mst. Amina Khatun mother of the pre-emptecs by a registered kabala deed dated 20.06.1987. The pre-emptees are strangers to the land under pre-emption. In fact the deed of ewaznama was fraudulently registered to defect the right of pre-emption of the plaintiffs, hence the suit.
